title: Billing-Delay Goodwill on Late-Posted Microsoft 365 Reduction Credits
content:
A Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) reduction credit that is posted late carries Stratton Bay's billing-delay goodwill. The goodwill depends on the calendar days between the reduction's submission date and the posting date:

- more than 30 calendar days: **50.00 USD** is added to the reduction credit;
- 8 to 30 calendar days: **25.00 USD** is added;
- 7 days or fewer: nothing is added.

The submission date comes from the in-window reduction's record. The posting date is the date the reduction credit is posted.

## Boundary table

| Calendar days from submission date to posting date | Goodwill added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | none |
| 8 | 25.00 USD |
| 30 | 25.00 USD |
| 31 | 50.00 USD |
| more than 31 | 50.00 USD |

## Hypothetical dates

- A reduction is submitted on 2 April and its credit is posted on 9 April, 7 days later. Nothing is added.
- The same reduction credited on 10 April, 8 days later, takes 25.00 USD.
- Credited on 2 May, which is 30 days later, it still takes 25.00 USD.
- Credited on 3 May, which is 31 days later, it takes 50.00 USD.
